current.text: He competes with Jeremiah Fears for the last starting spot in a crowded Pelicans rotation. Zion Williamson, Trey Murphy, Dejounte Murray and likely Yves Missi hold the other four spots.
A Pelicans beat reporter expects Jeremiah Fears to start over him.

The experts are lukewarm and do not agree on his draft value. One puts him in the right area for later-round steals but is not a big fan. Another doubts he is worth drafting in standard category leagues.

durable.text: His fantasy value comes mainly from steals. He adds some blocks and the occasional three, but he rarely shoots and scores little.
He is worth more in category leagues than in points leagues.
FG% is his weakest category. It is weak for his position.
He is not a true floor spacer, even though he once shot about 42% from three.

tags.detail: Projected 40.7% FG on about 8 attempts per game

tags.name: minutes competition
tags.detail: Competes with Jeremiah Fears for the last starting spot. A beat reporter favors Fears.

note: Both sites value Herbert Jones at 0 USD and rank him 134 on Yahoo and 194 on ESPN, so he sits right at the edge of our 144-player draft. Our league paid 5 USD for him last season, which is too much now. In a punt FG% build he is a cheap steals source at about 1.5 per game, worth 1 to 2 USD at the end of the draft. If no one takes him, he is a waiver option. Early in the season, check whether he keeps his starting spot over Jeremiah Fears and whether his FG% gets back above the 38.3% he shot last season.
